data.long_meaning: Sahajan is a Sanskrit name that means 'easy' or 'natural'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sahaj', which means 'easy' or 'natural'. The name reflects the simplicity and effortlessness of nature, and is a reminder that even the most complex things can be approached with ease. The name Sahajan carries the meaning “Easy, natural” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sahajan usually hope their child will grow to embody easy, natural and live with faith, good character and purpose.
